fact: In January 2024 INTERPOL's SIPAO newsletter said its main 2024 priority for Chad was to finish renovating the building for the SIPT and make the system fully operational so that Chadian users could begin recording criminal data, and the national SIPT focal point said implementation was only beginning and that CREDOP would need to become an institution with its own management and budget once the programme withdrew.
title: Lettre d'information SIPAO, numéro 24
